messages:
Cassie B.: Quick ops note for Tues launch — need final decision on what we ship as "highlight clip" vs full replay. Also confirm Zoom recording settings and lead dedupe rules.
Ravi K.: For clips — 3 x 60s highlight cuts (product teaser, benchmark result, CTO soundbite) + full replay. Agree?
Lina M.: Agree on clips. Also: can we prioritize auto-caption + speaker-labeling? We need those for intl social posts.
Tom H.: Zoom settings I'd recommend:
```
- Record to cloud (separate audio files)
- Enable automatic captions
- Host: cassie@redwood.com
- Co-hosts: tom@redwood.com, lina@redwood.com
- Cloud recording: record active speaker + gallery
- Auto-transcribe: on
```
Cassie B.: @Tom can you confirm SRT + individual track export? We might need .vtt for uploads.
Tom H.: Cloud gives .vtt. For SRT we can convert with ffmpeg: `ffmpeg -i transcript.vtt subtitle.srt`. OpsBot: Recording scheduled for 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC. Reminder 30m before.
OpsBot: Zoom link: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/1234567890
Ravi K.: Lead dedupe plan: HubSpot ingestion => dedupe by email, then attribute to campaign: "launch-q2-scalebench". Remove test domains (eg @example.com, @test.local).
Lina M.: Post-event nurture: immediate replay email within 1h, clip drip (24h, 48h), and segment for high-engagement (watched >50%) to receive "book a demo" CTA.
Cassie B.: Owners: edit + captions -> Lina; clip selection -> Ravi; HubSpot flow -> Tom. Can we get first-cut edits by EOD Wed?
Ravi K.: I can do clips by Wed EOD. Tagging: add lead tags `webinar_launch_q2` and `scalebench_interest`.
Tom H.: I'll set up HubSpot workflows and dedupe rules today. Will also export registrant list + watch metrics after 24h.
Lina M.: Quick checklist for post-edit priorities:
- high-engagement clip (60s)
- benchmark highlight clip (60s)
- full replay w/ captions
- transcript (.vtt)
- social teasers (15s)
Cassie B.: Perfect. If no blockers, we'll proceed. Flag here if anything slips.
Tom H.: One potential blocker: if cloud recording fails, fallback plan = local recording on host + upload to S3. I'll add upload steps to the runbook: `aws s3 cp local_recording.mp4 s3://redwood-prod-recordings/`.
Cassie B.: Thanks all :thumbsup:
